{"title": "Adhyaya 1 — Narada's question", "summary": "In the Naimisha forest the rishis ask Suta which vow yields the wished-for fruit."}

In the Naimisha forest, Shaunaka and the other rishis asked Suta which vow or austerity yields the wished-for fruit. The first verse of the katha poses exactly this question:

{{verse:satyanarayan-vrat-katha-sanskrit-1-1}}

Suta answered with the story that Narada himself had heard from the Lord. In the puja, the [[kalash]] is set up before this reading begins. Tradition holds that this vow is the simplest one of the Kali age.

{{verse:satyanarayan-vrat-katha-sanskrit-1-2}}
